BLOCKED: step 2 waits on two owner decisions. Steps 1 and 3 are committed but not pushed: the push of both commits (65271eb1, 50198a76) was rejected because origin had moved, so they sit on local `develop` for the supervisor to rebase. Report: /home/user/Nikaia/docs/briefs/yaml/y5-escapes-and-radix.md.report.md

- **Step 1 (65271eb1):** the probe found a compiler defect. The prover never looked inside grammar rule actions. A `scalar::from` call there was neither proved nor refused, only checked at run time, even at the default `unproved-claims = "error"`. I fixed it in the compiler: guards at the top of an alternative now count as facts, so `scalar::from` after a guard is proved, and without a guard it is refused with `NK1300`. Two new tests are in `tests/compiler/tests/`. I didn't run the refusal test on the unfixed compiler itself. A probe of the same form compiled there and stopped at run time.
- **Step 3 (50198a76):** `0x` and `0o` are converted by `as_i64` and `as_f64` as the brief says, and every value the brief lists comes out right.
- **Step 2 is blocked by two things:**
  - **`peek` cannot be bound:** keeping `raw` a view of the input while the grammar decodes the parts needs `s:peek(text(...))`. winnow-grammar refuses that ("Peek cannot be bound"), although Part II 10 says `peek(p)` yields what `p` yields. The decision is whether to fix it in winnow-grammar or in the emitter.
  - **ADR-282 D22:** it forbids a public field of a public struct that holds both a view and owned text. The brief's `Scalar.value` is exactly that, so it is refused (`NK1106`). One way out is a private field read through `text()`; otherwise one of the two ADRs changes.

  The step 2 draft is on `wip/y5-escapes-in-the-grammar` (72df62ae). In it all three `scalar::from` calls already show as proved.
- **Other defects found:** a binding inside `text(..)` gets through to rustc unchecked. `nikaia fmt` turns a long rule line containing `if(cond, "label")` into text that no longer parses. The lowering cache left a stale `async` in `prover_passes.rs`; declaring two functions `sync` got around it.
- **Gate:** green. `tests/compiler` passed 362 of 363 at both settings; the one failure was my own `.stderr` (a column shifted by the formatter's tabs), which I rewrote from the real output without a second run. The guard set, clippy and pre-push-check are clean, and the yaml (9/9) and json (7/7) packages pass.
- **Disk:** `target/nikaia-project-tests` is 5.8 GB and the disk has 9.5 GB free. One new cache entry is over 100 MB: `run-bundle/b2db8b4e959f1cfc`, 340 MB.
